items.title: Albert Morgan Interview, 1958-08-19
items.q: He said, I'd like to take you on the boat with me... So I made up my mind to go with him.

ctx.x: Oh, so do I get in? I'll turn it off for a second. Can you mind me a little bit more about that job at the Astoria Hotel, or what do they call it, the ballroom, really?

Yes, it was the Astoria Roof. Roof. Oh, it was on the roof, though. Yeah, well no, that's what they call it, Astoria Roof, yeah. David Jones developed a very fine band up there. It's one of the trombone players of Celestan's A, Tuxedo, probably the trombone, Bay, Bay, yeah. Yeah, that's the guy. And we had a nice little band for a long time up there. And then, and I stayed with him, and almost was about to learn to play that bass horn pretty fair. Yeah. Well, the big thing that happened to me, and started me on…

The kid said, I heard a lot of talk of you. I had to come down and look you over. I can see now what the people on there. He said, I'd like to take you on the boat with me. I told him, I said, well, I don't read. He said, well, that's all right. Many of them from here, everyone I've taken from here I couldn't read. But you will if you stick with me a long time. I said, well, I don't know. I'll try. So he'd come back again in the afternoon. So I made up my mind to go with him. About what year was that? Oh, that…
